text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon is hosting a holiday meet and greet with her fans. We head to the event space together to find…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wow, there's so many people! Do you think some huge idol is holding an event?
choice_data_list: I think there's an event for a huge Umadol called Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …What?! You mean all these people are my fans?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wooow… This is… amazing!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hello, Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We were expecting you to arrive two minutes and forty seconds ago. Please hurry to the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Flash? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's not just me. There's also…

text_block_list.name: Dirt Runner B
text_block_list.text: This is the line to meet Falco! The line for merchandise is on the other side!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wow… They're all here to help me out?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain that a number of runners she's faced in the past gladly offered to help as soon as she announced the meet and greet.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Everyone is very grateful for your efforts in promoting dirt racing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It seems they were looking for a way to repay you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aw… Sniffle… I'm gonna cry.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And thank you too, Flash! ☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I just happened to have time in my schedule. Don't mention it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: On that note, if this drags on, it will be a problem. Please proceed to the waiting room right away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, more than double the expected amount of fans show up to the meet, each and every one of them showing incredible passion.

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa… You're so cute!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text: Um, I've only just recently become your fan, but I'll be supporting you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text: Watching you run so hard for the top always gives me energy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! ♪ I'm gonna keep on running just like that! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I-is everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, a notepad! Let's see…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "I love you!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you! ☆ Message received loud and clear! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks for finding the courage to make it here today! Please keep supporting me!

text_block_list.name: Emotional Fan
text_block_list.text: …D-d-def… def… Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Pigtails
text_block_list.text: Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're the girl from the riverbank! You came! ☆

text_block_list.name: Girl with Pigtails
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You shined so bright today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Thank you! ☆ That makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I got your letter too! The glittery stickers you decorated it with were so cute! ☆ Thanks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Girl with Pigtails
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. By the way, I decided what I wanna be when I grow up!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Pigtails
text_block_list.text: I wanna be an Umadol, just like you!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Pigtails
text_block_list.text: Let's sing together someday! Wait for me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll be waiting for you on the sparkling stage!

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan B
text_block_list.text: I just love how powerfully you run! You're so cool… and cute… I love you, Falcooo!

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan C
text_block_list.text: Seeing you work so hard is what keeps me going… It makes me want to devote everything to running.

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan C
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Falco… Thank you for becoming an Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I should be the one thanking you! I'm so glad that you found me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The kind words of her many fans energize Smart Falcon. Finally, during her concluding remarks…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I've been a bit flustered lately.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All I've been able to think about is that I need to win—that I need to be at the top.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I felt like it was all on me to make dirt racing more popular, which turned into a lot of pressure.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: You don't have to worry about that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks! ☆ And you're right! I'm totally okay now!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You know why? Because I got to see everyone's faces up close and personal today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm so lucky to have received so much warmth from everyone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So I thought to myself today… Maybe being at the top isn't what's most important.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What's important is that I accept everyone's feelings and shine as bright as I can!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm the Umadol of the dirt, but I'm also everybody's Umadol! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The meet and greet comes to a close amidst great merriment. Next up…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last—the Tokyo Daishoten awaits us!
